name: 家庭科教師
text:
────さっき配ったプリントは
宿題にしますので、来週提出してくださいね
trans:
────I've just passed down the prints that will be
today's homework, so please hand them in next week.

name: 家庭科教師
text: 授業の中で基本的な間取りの種類を説明しましたが──
trans:
Though I've gone through the types of apartment
layouts in class earlier──

name: 家庭科教師
text:
理想の家をイメージするのは難しいかもしれません
もし行き詰ったら、住みたいと思う家を考えてみてください
trans:
It might still be difficult to imagine your ideal home.
If you're stuck, you can try to think of a house you'd
want to live in.

name: 家庭科教師
text:
どんな家が自分にとって居心地がいいか
楽しいと感じるか……自由に考えてみてくださいね
trans:
Try to think freely...... What kind of a house you'd
feel comfortable in, or a house that you'd enjoy
staying in......

name: 家庭科教師
text: ──それでは授業を終わります
trans: ──And that'd be end of today's class.

name: 雛菜
text: んー……

name: 雛菜
text: あ
trans: Ah.

name: 雛菜
text: （不動産屋さんだ……）
trans:
(Ah, a property agency......)
(TL note: In Japan, they have shops in Japan that
assist with real estate)

name: 雛菜
text:
（いろんな部屋あるけど……
雛菜が住みたいやつは────）
trans:
(There's all sorts of rooms for rent listed here,
but...... None of them look like what Hinana wants to
live in────)

name: 雛菜
text: （ないかも）
trans: (I think...)

name: 雛菜
text: （雛菜のお城は、もっと────）
trans: (A castle for Hinana feels more like────)

name: 円香
text: ……雛菜
trans: ......Hinana.

name: 雛菜
text: なんだ、円香先輩か～
trans: Oh, it's Madoka-senpai, huh～

name: 円香
text:
そこのチラシ見てたけど
部屋でも探してるの？
trans:
You were looking at that pin up earlier.
Are you looking for a room?

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～
違うよ～
trans:
Huh～
No I wasn't～

name: 雛菜
text: 今日、家庭科の授業で間取りのことやったから
trans:
We were just doing apartment layouts in home
economics class today.

name: 円香
text:
ああ……あれね
私も去年、同じことやった
trans:
Aah... I remember that.
Our class taught the same thing last year.

name: 雛菜
text: ふ～ん
trans: Hm～mph.

name: 雛菜
text: ね、円香先輩の理想の家って、どんなの？
trans: Hey, what's your ideal home like, Madoka-senpai?

name: 円香
text: は？
trans: Huh?

name: 円香
text: 急に聞かれても……そんなの、考えたことない
trans:
As if I'd know how to answer that so suddenly......
I've not thought about such things before.

name: 雛菜
text: ……そっか～

name: 雛菜
text:
雛菜はね、
広いドレッシングルーム欲しい～
trans: Hinana wants a huge dressing room～

name: 雛菜
text:
季節ごとのクローゼットがあるから、
それ開けるたびにしあわせ～になれるんだよ
trans:
I'll have closets that contain clothings for each
season, so whenever I open them, Hinana will feel so
happy～

name: 円香
text:
機能性に欠ける
クローゼットはひとつでいいでしょ
trans:
That's not very practical.
You just need one closet, don't you.

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～～～、なんで～？
絶対しあわせになれるのに～
trans:
Huh～～～But why～?
I'm sure that'd have made me super happy～

name: 雛菜
text:
ドレッシングルームとベッドルームはつながってて……
天蓋付きのベッドも置きたいかも～！
trans:
Then, I'll have my dressing room connected to the bed
room...... Maybe I'll have a bed that has a canopy too～!

name: 円香
text:
……まあ
想像するだけなら自由
trans: ......Well, you're free to imagine what you want.

name: 雛菜
text: じゃあ、円香先輩はどういう家に住みたいの～？
trans:
What about you, Madoka-senpai? What kind of a home
do you wanna stay in～?

name: 円香
text:
……住むのに困らない広さで
清潔で、セキュリティが充実してる
trans:
......I want a room that's not too large, so that it's
easy to clean and install home security.

name: 雛菜
text: ふ～ん、広さは～？
trans: Hm～mp, how spacious would that be～?

name: 円香
text:
広すぎても持て余すし
平均より少し広いくらいでいいんじゃない？
trans:
It would be hard to maintain if it's too big, so I think
it'd be perfect if it's just slightly bigger than an
average room?

name: 円香
text:
ひとり暮らしの荷物なんて
たかが知れてるんだから
trans:
It's not rocket science figuring out what you need
when living alone, after all.

name: 雛菜
text: そんなの住むだけじゃない～？
trans: But a room isn't just used to live in, right～?

name: 円香
text: 住めれば上等
trans: Living in it would be more than enough.

name: 円香
text:
……違うって思ったなら
参考になったんじゃない？
trans:
......If it's different from what you imagine, then that
can also serve as a reference of what you wouldn't
want, right?

name: 雛菜
text:
そうだね……
なったかも～
trans:
I suppose so......
That could help, maybe～

name: 雛菜
text:
この中にある～？
円香先輩の住みたい家
trans:
Do you think there's one among these～?
A house that Madoka-senpai wants to live in.

name: 円香
text: ……ない

name: 雛菜
text: １DKも１LDKもあるのに
trans:
Even though there are 1DK and 1 LDK options?
(TL note: L- Living room, D- Dinning room, K- Kitchen)

name: 円香
text:
家賃とか、設備とか、駅近とか
そういう────
trans:
There's factors like cost of rent, facilities,
accessibility to train stations, so-on────

name: 円香
text: ……いや、もう帰る
trans: ......Forget it, I'm going home.

name: 雛菜
text: あ、じゃあ雛菜も帰る～
trans: Ah, then Hinana will go home too～

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜がお城建てたら、円香先輩も来たい～？
trans:
If Hinana builds a castle, would Madoka-senpai
want to come visit～?

name: 円香
text:
はいはい
建てたらね
trans:
Yes, yes, sure I will.
If you build one.

name: 雛菜
text: ……建てるよ～
trans: ......I'll build it～

name: 雛菜
text: 絶対
trans: One day.
